title: Remove docs for deleted function `route_intent`
summary: `route_intent` was removed from `backend/services/supervisor_bridge.py` in commit a1b2c3d. Existing documentation in the API reference and module README still describe this function and will mislead developers.
proposed_diff:
--- a/docs/api-reference.md
+++ b/docs/api-reference.md
@@ -140,32 +140,0 @@
-## route_intent
-
-Routes an intent from the UI through the supervisor bridge.
-...

title: Update signature docs for `classify_transactions`
summary: `classify_transactions` in `kylo/classify_transactions.py` gained a new required parameter `dry_run: bool` in commit d4e5f6. Documentation and usage examples still show the old two-argument signature and will cause runtime errors if followed.
proposed_diff:
--- a/kylo/README.md
+++ b/kylo/README.md
@@ -90,7 +90,7 @@
-classify_transactions(rows, config)
+classify_transactions(rows, config, dry_run=False)
 
 Parameters
 ----------
 rows   : list[dict]  Raw transaction rows
 config : dict        Classification rule config
+dry_run: bool        If True, log actions but write nothing (default False)

title: Update 6 path references after gigatt-transport backend rename
summary: `gigatt-transport/backend/api/dispatch.py` was renamed to `gigatt-transport/backend/api/router.py` in commit g7h8i9. Six documentation files contain the old path as string literals, import examples, or hyperlinks.

decision.rationale: Path rename confirmed. All 6 references need updating.

title: Config key `WORKER_TUNNEL_URL` renamed — update deployment docs
summary: `WORKER_TUNNEL_URL` was renamed to `WORKER_API_URL` in `backend/.env.example` in commit j1k2l3. The old key name is documented in the deployment runbook and README. Fresh deployments following the old docs will fail to connect to the worker.
proposed_diff:
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -43,3 +43,3 @@
-WORKER_TUNNEL_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8765
+WORKER_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8765
 
 # SSH tunnel must be open: ssh -L 8765:localhost:8765 worker-rig

decision.rationale: Rename not finalised yet — still deciding the new key name. Defer 48 hours.
